title: BoingusSMP 21
description: This modpack includes Cobblemon 1.7, Create, Terralith, and many mods aiming to provide players the ability to make fun minigames. Stable enough for playtesting.
body:
This modpack is designed with multiplayer in mind. It includes Cobblemon 1.7, Create, Terralith, and many tools for creating **mini-games** and **interesting pokemon gyms**.


Some core vanilla mechanics are adjusted:
- Monsters do not spawn under the sky. You will still find monsters in the underworld and in shadowy forests; but the surface is much safer.
- Sleep is disabled, but beds will still set your spawnpoint. Phantoms are disabled.
- Most structures (including villages) are much rarer.
- Animals provide much more leather and even bones.
- Some recipe tweaks and additions.


Default Gamerules: (_via datapack: adjustable in datapacks/boingustweaks_)
- KeepInventory is true
- doFireTick is false


Other notable mods are:
- Armourer's Workshop
- Automobility
- CC: Tweaked
- Joy of Painting
- Serene Seasons
- Supplementaries
- Water Frames
- ... and many others (see newest version for mod list)
